description: MAF sensor contamination causing false lean readings. The hot-wire element is coated with oil/debris, under-reporting airflow by 25-35% with erratic spikes. ECU over-fuels to compensate, causing elevated trims and occasional misfires under load.

ground_truth_eval_only.root_cause: MAF sensor contamination (hot-wire element coated with oil/debris)

discriminators.maf_fault: MAF readings are erratic with high variance and occasional wild spikes; MAF does not correlate smoothly with RPM/load. The coefficient of variation of MAF residuals vs. expected MAF is much higher than a healthy sensor.
discriminators.vacuum_leak: MAF reads low but tracks RPM/load smoothly with a consistent proportional offset; no erratic spikes.
discriminators.weak_fuel_delivery: Trims go NEGATIVE at high load; fuel pressure drops under demand.
discriminators.ignition_fault: Misfires concentrated on specific cylinders; trims near normal.
discriminators.o2_sensor_fault: O2 voltage flatlined while trims show active closed-loop correction.

notes: Ground truth for evaluation only; never exposed through MCP tools.
